header_sentences: See New Jerusalem; and see Zion.

contexts.text: That Jerusalem = Heaven, whence it is called... the heavenly Jerusalem.
The holy Jerusalem = the Lord's Kingdom in the universal; or in each person in whom is the Lord's Kingdom.
The city of Truth, or Jerusalem, = the spiritual things of faith.
On the filthy Jerusalem. AC 940:2. AC 956. LJCont 79. SE 1195. SE 3559. SE 3851.
The sons of Jerusalem () = the spiritual things of faith. AC 1197:end.
Jerusalem = the Lord's Kingdom, and the Church. AC 1857:end. AC 2348.
The holy Jerusalem () = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
By Jerusalem is signified the Lord's Church. AC 3448:10. AC 3654:2. AC 5480:end. AR 447:3.
All things in the middle of Canaan... represented His internal man, as Mount Zion and Jerusalem; the former, celestial things, and the latter, spiritual ones.
Zion = the Celestial Church; Jerusalem, the Spiritual Church. AC 2576:12. AC 2607:2.
Jerusalem () = the Ancient Church. AC 5319:2. AC 5433:6. AC 9995:4. AC 10540:2.
It treats of the abominations of Jerusalem...
The street of Jerusalem () = the falsities which reign in the Church.
Jerusalem = the Lord's Kingdom.
The affection of truth constitutes the Spiritual Church, and is called in the Word the daughter of Jerusalem. AC 2362:3. AC 3024:2. AC 3081:3.
Concerning Jerusalem, by which is here signified the Church perverted as to truths.
Samaria = the Church which is in the affection of truth; Jerusalem, the Church which is in the affection of good.
When Jerusalem is mentioned, they do not perceive that Jerusalem which was in the tribes of Benjamin and Judah, but the holy and heavenly Jerusalem.
Jerusalem = the Ancient Church, which was spiritual. AC 3103:2. AC 3147:5. AC 3301:5. AC 5954:5. AC 6432:3. AC 6804:9.
The City Jerusalem = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom and Church.
The inhabitants of Jerusalem = those in the good of charity and of faith.
In that land (of Moriah) was Jerusalem, where the Lord Himself endured the last of temptation. Explained.
They will fight against Jerusalem () = ... against the Lord's Spiritual Church, and its truths...
The gift of Jerusalem () = worship from spiritual love.
That Hebron represented the Church before Jerusalem did so. Explained.

After David had reigned at Hebron seven years and six months, he went to Jerusalem, and occupied Zion (. ); and then first the Lord's Spiritual Church began to be represented by Jerusalem; and the Celestial Church by Zion.
By the Land of Canaan was represented the Lord's Kingdom; the Celestial of it by Zion, and the Spiritual by Jerusalem.

Hence it is that to ascend is predicated of [going] towards Jerusalem; but to descend [of going] from Jerusalem; and also from Jerusalem to Zion, and from Zion to Jerusalem; for by the things which were around Jerusalem are signified the exteriors of the Church; but by Jerusalem, the interiors; and by Zion, the inmosts.
When ye shall see Jerusalem encompassed with armies () = the Lord's Church.
Worship from faith is the meat-offering of Jerusalem ().
The middle of the Land was Beersheba, before Jerusalem...
The consummation of the Third Church is not described in the Word, but is foretold, which was the destruction of Jerusalem... AC 4333:2.
Therefore they were restricted (in their worship)... to the mountain where Jerusalem was, and at last to where Zion was... AC 4580:3.

For Jerusalem was the inmost of the Land, because by it was signified the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; and the House of God was the inmost of Jerusalem, because by it was signified the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, and, in the supreme sense, the Lord Himself. Hence it is said to ascend to them.

As by Benjamin was represented the Spiritual of the Celestial of the Church, or the truth of good, which is intermediate between celestial good and spiritual truth, therefore Jerusalem was ceded as an inheritance to the sons of Benjamin; for Jerusalem, before Zion was built there, = the Church in general. That Jerusalem was ceded to Benjamin, see ; .
That hence is the Spiritual Kingdom of the Celestial, is signified by, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem ().
The City, or Jerusalem () = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
Concerning Jerusalem, by which is signified the Spiritual of the Celestial Church.

Jerusalem () = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. This Kingdom is also meant by the New Jerusalem in Ezekiel; and also by the holy Jerusalem descending from heaven, in the Revelation. The Lord's Spiritual Kingdom is where the principal thing is Divine truth in which is good... Hence it is evident why Jerusalem is called the throne of Jehovah.
The holy City Jerusalem () = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom in the Heavens, and His Spiritual Church on earth, of which glory is predicated.
Therefore Jerusalem was called holy, when yet in itself it was filthy.
To restore and build Jerusalem ()... Jerusalem, here, = a new Church.
Sion and Jerusalem = the Celestial Church; Sion, its internal; and Jerusalem, its external.

When Sion and Jerusalem are mentioned together, the Celestial Church is signified by them; by Sion, its internal; and by Jerusalem, its external. But when Jerusalem is mentioned without Sion, it then for the most part = the Spiritual Church.
Jerusalem = the Spiritual Church; thus the good of charity and of the derivative faith.
Jerusalem = the Celestial Spiritual Church; Samaria, the Spiritual Church.
By Jerusalem is signified the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, in which are they who are in good from truth, and in truth from good.
By Jerusalem is meant the perverted Church. AC 10283:9.

Hence by Jerusalem in the Word, and by the New Jerusalem in the Apocalypse, is signified the Lord's Church; and the Lord's Church is with everyone who is in a state of reception of charity and faith from the Lord; for man himself is the Church; and a number with whom the Church is make the Church in general.

To swear by Jerusalem () = by the doctrine of truth from the Word; for Jerusalem in a wide sense = the Church. But when the earth is mentioned, which = the Church, and then Jerusalem, Jerusalem = the doctrine of the Church, consequently, the doctrine of Divine truth from the Word. Hence it is that it is called the city of the great God.
Jerusalem is here called the holy city, when yet it was rather profane, because the Lord had then been crucified there.
The salvation of those who were of the Spiritual Church, and their elevation into the Holy Jerusalem, which is Heaven. Signified.
To fight against Jerusalem = against the Church, thus also against the truths and goods of faith, which make the Church.
Jerusalem, to which the nations shall be gathered () = this new Church. AC 9487:2.
Jerusalem () = the Church which is in falsities from evil.
By Jerusalem is signified the Church with those who are in truths from good.
Jerusalem () = the Lord's Church; and, in a more eminent sense, Heaven.
That by Jerusalem is signified the Church as to doctrine. References.

What is meant by Jerusalem in the Word, in its spiritual sense, is known to few. By Jerusalem is meant the Church itself as to doctrine; and this because there and not elsewhere in the Land of Canaan there was a temple, an altar, sacrifices were performed, thus Divine worship itself. Therefore also three feasts were celebrated there annually, and every male of the whole Land was commanded to go to them. Hence then it is that by Jerusalem in the spiritual sense is signified the Church as to worship; or, what is the same, as to doctrine; for worship is prescribed in doctrine, and is effected according to it... AR 880.

In that quarter there are two great cities into which the Jews are brought after death; and which before the Judgment they called Jerusalems; but after it by another name; because after the Judgment, by Jerusalem is understood the Church (as to doctrine) in which the Lord alone is adored. TCR 841.

That by Jerusalem in these passages is meant the Church which was to be established by the Lord, and which also has been established, and not the Jerusalem in the Land of Canaan... may be evident from the passages in the Word where it is said of this Jerusalem that it has been completely destroyed, and that it is to be destroyed. Illustrated. AR 880:8.
(In the Word in Heaven) instead of Zion and Jerusalem, there is the Church as to the Word, and as to doctrine from the Word.
By Jerusalem is signified the Church as to doctrine.
Jerusalem which shall be trodden down = the Church.
Jerusalem () = the Israelitish and Jewish Church.
A pestilential smoke from the Jerusalem which is called Sodom and Egypt... BE 114. TCR 567.
One of the Jerusalemite cities, where charity is primary... TCR 388:4.
That by Jerusalem is meant the Church as to doctrine and the derivative worship. Illustrated.
It is this new Church which is meant by Jerusalem...
The Jerusalemite Temple.
, , and  do not describe the destruction of the Temple and of Jerusalem, but foretell the successive changes of the state of the Christian Church...
That by Jerusalem in these passages is meant the Church to be established by the Lord. Illustrated, Explained. TCR 782:5.
By Jerusalem is not meant any city from Heaven; but the Church which will descend out of Heaven from the Lord.

That by Jerusalem is meant the Church, is perspicuously evident from the propheticals in the Old Testament concerning the new Church to be established by the Lord, in that it is there called Jerusalem. Illustrated.
In these passages by Jerusalem is meant the Holy New Jerusalem, described in the Apocalypse, by which is meant the New Church. Illustrated.
The old Jerusalem (in the Spiritual World) SE 3385. SE 3409.
On Jerusalem and the Temple after the captivity. (The dates given.)
The reason this was done when the Lord went (triumphantly) into Jerusalem, was that by Jerusalem is signified the Church.
Behold, we go up to Jerusalem ()... Jerusalem, here, = the Jewish Church.
Jerusalem = the Lord's Church in the Heavens and on earth...
Jerusalem = the Spiritual Kingdom and the Spiritual Church.
The reason Jerusalem is called the holy city, is that by it in the spiritual sense is meant the Church as to the doctrine of truth. AE 208:11. AE 223:9. AE 223:11.
Jerusalem () = the Church in which there are not goods, but evils.
Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine, thus Divine truth in the Heavens and on earth; for this makes the Church, AE 298:3.
Jerusalem = the Church which is in truths from this good.
Jerusalem = the Church where is the doctrine of Divine truth.
Jerusalem, over which the Lord wept, = the Church, which was then completely vastated...
Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine and worship.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the truths of doctrine.
Here, Jerusalem is called Salem (), because by Salem is signified peace; from which Jerusalem also was named. The reason it was so named, is that peace = all the things mentioned above.
Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine; or, what is the same, the doctrine of the Church. AE 388:15. AE 540:6. AE 734:16.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the doctrine of truth.
To build Jerusalem = to establish the Church.
The inhabitants of Jerusalem = all who are of the Church.
The streets of Jerusalem = the truths of the Church.
The king of Jerusalem () = the truth of the Church completely vastated by falsities.
Jerusalem the evangelizatress () = the Church which is thence from the Word in the truths of doctrine.
Jerusalem = the Church as to truths, and thence the Divine truths of the Church.

Therefore Mount Zion was built above Jerusalem... Jerusalem the Church which is in truths from that good, or the Church as to doctrine; and therefore also Jerusalem is called the mountain, and also the hill, of holiness...
Because Mount Zion and Jerusalem were built as much as could be done in the form of Heaven...

Jerusalem is builded as a city which coheres with itself together () = the Church as to doctrine... when all things of its doctrine are in agreement and unanimity with each other, and when they mutually regard the Lord and love to Him from Him as the beginning and the end.
The sons of Jerusalem = the truths of the Word.
That this Church will be safe from the infestation of evils and falsities, is signified by. Jerusalem shall dwell under itself in Jerusalem ().
Jerusalem = the Church where are the truths of doctrine.

As Benjamin... = truth conjoined with good in the natural man, therefore his lot in the Land of Canaan was between the sons of Judah and between the sons of Joseph; and also to that tribe was ceded Jerusalem, where then were the Jebusites, for an inheritance (); so that the sons of Benjamin dwelt there together with the Jews, who afterwards occupied that city... The reason Jerusalem was ceded to that tribe, was that Jerusalem signified the Church as to doctrine and as to worship; and all the doctrine of the Church is the doctrine of truth conjoined with good; and all worship according to doctrine is effected by means of the natural man...
Jerusalem = the doctrine of truth.
Jerusalem = the truth of the Church.
To number the houses of Jerusalem () = to falsify the goods of truth. For the houses of Jerusalem = the goods of truth of the Church.
Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine, and consequently the truths of doctrine of the Church.
Jerusalem = the truth of doctrine.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the truth of doctrine, consequently the truth of doctrine of the Church.
Jerusalem = the Church in which is the truth of doctrine.
Jerusalem = the Church where the truth of doctrine reigns.
Jerusalem the metropolis of the Jews = the Celestial Church as to doctrine.
Jerusalem = the Church and its doctrine.

Jerusalem encompassed with armies... = the Church as to doctrine... taken possession of by falsities... These things are not said of the destruction of Jerusalem by the Romans... but of the destruction of the Church at its end... But still... by these words in the sense of the letter there is meant the destruction of Jerusalem; but this destruction represented and thence signified the destruction of the Church at its end.
Jerusalem = the Celestial Church.
Jerusalem the Church as to the truths of doctrine.

That this Church will be safe from the infestation of evils and falsities, and will live in the good of life according to the truths of doctrine, is signified by, Jerusalem shall dwell longer under itself in Jerusalem. Jerusalem = the Church as to the truths of doctrine.
Its hill, or Jerusalem, = the Spiritual Church.
Jerusalem = the doctrine of the Church; therefore it is called the city of the great God.
By Jerusalem are meant all who are of the Spiritual Church, who are they who are in the doctrine of genuine truth.
Jerusalem = the Ancient Church.
Jerusalem = the Church; first, the Ancient Church and afterwards the Israelitish Church.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the doctrine of truth.
Jerusalem = this new Church.

By the holy City, in the sense of the letter, is meant Jerusalem, which in the Word -passim- is called the holy City and city; but by Jerusalem is meant the Church; and by City the doctrine of the Church.
Jerusalem shall be trodden down = that the Church as to doctrine shall be destroyed. AE 811.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the truths of doctrine; and therefore Jerusalem is called the city of Truth.
The streets of Jerusalem = the truths of doctrine; here, its falsities of doctrine.
To the restoring and building of Jerusalem ()... = the Church which will be established by the Lord. AE 684:36.
Jerusalem, where the Jews were, = the Celestial Church.
Jerusalem = the Church as to the truth of doctrine.
Aholibah which was Jerusalem = ... the Celestial Church. ( = the Celestial Church as to doctrine. AE 724:32.)
Jerusalem = the Church where mere falsities and evils reign.
Because in the city of Jerusalem, and outside of it, all the places corresponded to places in the Spiritual World...
As Jerusalem signified Heaven and the Church as to doctrine...

(By this) is signified the profanation of Divine truth... if instruction in it were represented anywhere else than in Jerusalem, by which was signified the Church as to the doctrine of truth and good, and as to instruction from the Word.
The restoration of the Church which had lapsed into mere falsities of evil, is signified by, Wake up, wake up, arise, Jerusalem... (). Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine.
(The reason every male went up three times a year) was that by Jerusalem was signified the Church as to doctrine, and thence also the doctrine of the Church.
Jerusalem = the doctrine of the Church.
Jerusalem = the doctrine of the Church from the Word.

It was also from this reason that by Jerusalem, which lay under that mountain, is signified the Church as to doctrine; for all the doctrine of the Church is from the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord, consequently from the Word. The reason that city was built upon a mountain, was that at that time mountains from their height represented the Heavens.
By Jerusalem is meant Heaven and the Church as to doctrine from this Divine truth; therefore it is said... the discourse of Jehovah shall go forth from Jerusalem (). AE 850:7.
Jerusalem = doctrine thence.
Jerusalem = the Celestial Church as to doctrine.
The like is signified by metropolitan cities as by the kingdoms; as the Jewish kingdom by Jerusalem.
The new Church to be established by the Lord is meant by Jerusalem.
To the mountain of My holiness, Jerusalem () = the Church in which charity reigns.

Before the Judgment they called these two cities Jerusalem; but after the Judgment they changed the name by command, because after it there came everywhere into common discourse the Holy Jerusalem treated of in the Apocalypse, by which is signified the New Church, into which no one will enter who does not make the Messiah one with Jehovah, thus who does not worship the Lord alone.
Zion = the Church as to the Word; Jerusalem, the Church as to doctrine from the Word.
